b:
• Ask for no NHS pension to be taken from your locums. When you register with a bank or locum office, ask them not to deduct NHS pension contributions from locum shifts. Pension deductions on extra shifts can push you into a higher contribution tier and add to your pension growth for annual allowance purposes.
  • Check with the trust's pensions or payroll team how they handle it, and weigh up the pension benefit you give up.
  • Check whether the shift is paid through the same payroll as your main job or a separate one, and add it to the 60% tax check.
